title: Zehra ki hai rukhsati
body:
bane hain dulha ali..(2)
zehra ki hai rukhsati..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ghar me aayaate haq ka ujaala huwa
noor arz o samaa ka dobaala huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho qur'aan khud shaahwaala hua
mil gayi deen ko ek nayi zindagi
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jibraeele ameen ki munaadi hai ye
dekho ek shaahzaadi ki shaadi hai ye
<<DIVIDER>>
aur shaadi magar kitni saadi hai ye
na hai israaf aur na dikhaawa koyi
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kaisa saada jahez is dulhan ko mila
ek takya o charkha aur ek aasia
<<DIVIDER>>
ek khajooro ke patton ka bistar bhi tha
kooza o mashk aur ek suraahi mili
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aqde zahra o haidar ki ye sunnatein
momino tumpe bhi farz hai itaa'atein
<<DIVIDER>>
jaise andaaz zahra ki shaadi ke hain
us taraah byaah do apni beti ko bhi
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aqd ke aasmaan par fasaane bhi hain
huro gilmaan ke lab par taraane bhi hain
<<DIVIDER>>
sher kuch apne hamko sunaane bhi hain
momino tum bhi dohraawo misraa yehi
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Baithi binte payambar amaari me hain
saath huraane jannat sawaari me hain
<<DIVIDER>>
phul jannat ke phulon ki kyaari me hai
khushbu hai aaj phayli gali dar gali
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya ali ya ali..(2)
7. Ilm aur noor ke do samandar mile
<<DIVIDER>>
qurbatein badh gayi faasle mit gaye
leke binte nabi ko nabi khud chale
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya ali bol uthe har chaman har kali
8. Ju'n hi bayt e wilaayat me pohnchi dulhan
<<DIVIDER>>
aayaton se sajaa dekha sehne chaman
sura kausar ka karne laga ye sukhan
<<DIVIDER>>
mit nahi sakti taa hashr nasle nabi
9. Dekhiye to ay maajid samaa dekhiye
<<DIVIDER>>
khud payambar bhi hai shadmaan dekhiye
aaj bayt e ali me jinaa dekhiye
<<DIVIDER>>
jalne waale jalein ham kahenge yehi
author: Shadman Raza
